title: Finding a secondhand drawing book

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I'm looking for this drawing book. My old copy had a foldout grid. Does the blue cover mean this one has it?
turns.zh: 我在找這本素描書。我原來那本附有一張可展開的方格圖。這本是藍封面，就表示有那一頁嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No. The publisher used that cover twice. Check the printing note inside. Only the second printing came with a separate foldout grid in the back pocket.
turns.zh: 不一定。出版社用了那個封面兩次。看內頁的刷次說明。只有第二刷的書末袋子原本附有一張可展開的方格紙。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: This says second printing, but the pocket at the back is empty. I need the grid for class, not just the book.
turns.zh: 這本寫第二刷，但書末的袋子是空的。上課需要的是方格紙，不只是書。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Let's check the worn copy. If its grid is still in the pocket, the faded cover won't matter.
turns.zh: 來看看那本較舊的。如果方格紙還在袋子裡，封面褪色就沒關係。
